chunks: Al-Ayn: Via the three chains from al-Ridha, from his forefathers, from the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever gives fatwa to the people without knowledge, the angels of the heavens and the earth curse him.

key_terms.مَلَائِكَةُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ: the angels of the heavens and the earth

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of giving fatwa without knowledge in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith establishes the prohibition of issuing religious rulings (fatwa) without proper knowledge. It emphasizes the gravity of this error by stating that the angels of both the heavens and the earth curse those who do so.
